subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should maintainers consolidate one in-band separator-preservation PR, or require explicit boundary metadata for streamed block separators before fixing this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the permanent boundary contract affects shared streamed delivery semantics and two open PRs already propose a text-based fix shape.

options.title: Consolidate one separator-preserving PR
options.body: Review one linked PR as the canonical fix, require overflow and no-double-separator coverage, and close the other as superseded after a viable path is chosen.

options.title: Require boundary metadata
options.body: Pause both linked PRs until a metadata-carrying separator contract is designed and tested through the delivery pipeline.

options.title: Reject current fix direction
options.body: Close or redirect the linked PRs and leave this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored redesign.

recommendation.title: Consolidate one separator-preserving PR
recommendation.body: Review one linked PR as the canonical fix, require overflow and no-double-separator coverage, and close the other as superseded after a viable path is chosen.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and refined the paragraph streaming behavior now at the center of the boundary decision.
